column1: # lanes.tsv - T121. The lane table of scripts/test-in-container.sh (TIC): one reviewed row per (app, lane), naming the wrapper that runs it.
# Columns (TAB separated): app, lane, wrapper (a file of scripts/containers/, without .sh). Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Apps: catalog-api, catalog-web, qa, docs, tooling, build-scripts, catalogizer-desktop, installer-wizard (T200a). Lanes: unit, contract, integration, e2e, api, docs, render, tooling, rust (T200a).
# A new app or lane exists only by a REVIEWED row added here; TIC refuses any (app, lane) that has no row, with a non-zero exit (never a bare-host fallback).
# `qa` is a RESERVED app key with NO row: until T212 adds the run_qa.sh rows, `TIC qa ...` is refused as an unknown app, never sent to another image.
# The wrappers run_rust.sh and run_kcov.sh (T200a) and the Android rows of T204 (scripts/audit/android-container.sh, T145) are added by their own reviewed rows.
# The `site` column (remote / split / local, T121a) is added by T121a, which is blocked on the dispatcher scripts/build/dispatch.sh (T005b).
# T200a coverage rows (3 columns: the `site` column of T121a does not exist yet). `build-scripts unit` is the interpreter-class local lane of the bash line-trace
# harness (scripts/bash-coverage.sh, T199). The two `rust` rows name run_rust, class `compile`: a local start of it is refused with 20 compile_class_local

# (T121b), so they are safe before the dispatcher; they run only on a designated build host (a root-owned /etc/catalogizer/build-host naming the host; WF11 I8: the old RUNNER_REMOTE_CALL claim was false). HELD (BLOCKED on T121a, which adds the
# `site` column and the remote dispatch): the `run_node` rows `catalogizer-api-client unit`, `catalogizer-desktop unit`, `installer-wizard unit` and one
# `<module> unit` row per TypeScript submodule, because a run_node row with no site would run vitest on the LOCAL host, which T121a forbids.
